title: DAZN's New Partnership with Minnesota Timberwolves
description: DAZN has entered into a new media rights deal with the Minnesota Timberwolves, changing how fans can watch games.

sections.heading: New Media Rights Deal
paragraphs: According to The New York Times, the Minnesota Timberwolves have signed a new local media rights deal with DAZN, which will impact how fans can watch games.

sections.heading: Broadcasting Changes
paragraphs: Star Tribune reports that the Timberwolves' games will now be broadcast on DAZN, providing a new way for fans to watch the team play.

sections.heading: Direct-to-Fan Streaming
paragraphs: NBA.com highlights the launch of a new direct-to-fan streaming offering as part of the partnership between the Minnesota Timberwolves and DAZN.

faq.q: What is the new way to watch Minnesota Timberwolves games?
faq.a: According to Star Tribune, fans can now watch Minnesota Timberwolves games on DAZN.

faq.q: What does the partnership with DAZN involve?
faq.a: The partnership, as reported by NBA.com, includes the launch of a new direct-to-fan streaming offering for Minnesota Timberwolves games.
